phase: Phase 1: Red and Green for items 1 to 4
summary: The routed findings are fixed. Nine test files exit 0 with the counts the plan records. The preview.sh fallback leaves the published review output byte-identical. One defect stays in the changed lines: a missing review template publishes a fresh score file beside a stale public review page.
blocking_findings: F15 [Blocker] review-a: A missing review template leaves the public review page stale beside a fresh published score. update.sh:238-249 copies the preview review page into the candidate set whenever the consumed score differs from the published baseline, and it never checks that preview.sh rendered a new page. preview.sh:1079-1081 skips the render when harness/model-guide/pages/review.html is absent, so the preview folder keeps the old page copied from docs/. A temp run with that file removed and the score changed exited 0 and committed docs/assets/data/review.json with the new score. docs/review.html kept the old route state, so the public page shows a stale result. The routed C F7 fix guards the sibling template at update.sh:83-86 and update.sh:221-224, and the review template has no such guard. score-impact: yes.
nonblocking_findings: F16 [Nit] review-a: A first publication without a published baseline publishes the page but not the score file. update.sh:186-194 sets PUBLISH_REVIEW and leaves PUBLISH_SCORE at 0 when docs/assets/data/review.json is absent, and the branch at update.sh:245-249 then copies the score into the candidate folder for the leak scan only. A temp run with a complete score and no baseline committed docs/review.html and left docs/assets/data/review.json absent. The real repo tracks that file, so the weekly run takes the first branch. score-impact: no.

F17 [Nit] review-a: The track test strategy no longer matches the phase. measure/tracks/weekly_update_fix/test-strategy.md:143-145 requires that the phase leave harness/model-guide/preview.sh unchanged, and the Green commit 00d9013 changed it by 15 lines, so the Phase 1 closeout gate item 4 now fails. The rows at test-strategy.md:113-116 still describe the old scan scope and the preview folder. That file belongs to the user or a build session. score-impact: no.

F18 [Nit] review-a: The README weekly-update section does not name the review outputs or the new refusals. README.md:291 still says the commit holds the two data files plus the rebuilt pages, and it names only the `update: no approval record` refusal. The run now also commits docs/assets/data/review.json and prints `update: no private input` and `update: no overview template`. The run log names every committed path, so the PM weekly rule still holds. score-impact: no.
evidence: git rev-parse HEAD matched the supplied audited HEAD before and after the review. The tracked worktree matched HEAD.
The exact phase range 35a059c..a4e85da has 21 changed files. It leaves docs/ unchanged. It leaves the Measure registry and the framework orchestration scripts unchanged.

update-approval, update-pages, update-leak, update-exec, update, preview-gate, adversarial-p5, adversarial, and adversarial-p2 each exited 0 with --maxWorkers=1. Their labeled counts were 6, 11, 6, 6, 9, 122, 5, 46, and 13.
The nine counts equal the Green r6 evidence line at plan.md:160. bash -n on update.sh and preview.sh exited 0. The index shows mode 100755 for both scripts.

The Red r6 and r7 claims hold. At the base 8ceb628 the new update-approval case F1 fails and A1 to A5 pass. The five new update-pages cases F2a, F2b, F7, F9a, and F9b fail and P1 to P5 pass. The five update-leak cases L1, L2, L4, F4a, and F4b fail and L3 passes. The update file passes 9 cases at the base.

A read-only preview.sh run into a temp folder produced review.html and review.json byte-identical to docs/review.html and docs/assets/data/review.json. The tracked score file holds a non-empty top-level passes array, so the new fallback never runs for it.

A temp copy of the real tree with the real manifest and score file ran update.sh --docs. It exited 0 and committed only docs/assets/data/model-guide.json and docs/index.html. The two review outputs stayed byte-identical.

A temp copy with a changed score committed exactly the four files whose bytes changed. The published review.json equalled the score file byte for byte. The next run printed update: no change and made no commit.
A temp copy with a flagless run and the record present exited 0, wrote only .tmp/model-guide-preview, and made no commit. The docs tree stayed byte-identical.

A temp copy with a leak key in a candidate file refused with one line `update: leak docs/assets/data/review.json`, exit 2, no commit, and a byte-identical docs tree. A seeded private line in a candidate refused with the same line.
A temp copy with a leak key in docs/assets/data/benchmark.json, a file outside the candidate set, did not refuse. The scan covers the candidate files only.
A temp copy with a missing private input refused with `update: no private input`, exit 2, no commit, and a byte-identical docs tree.
A temp copy with a missing guide-section template refused with `update: no overview template`, exit 2, no commit, and a byte-identical docs tree.

A temp copy with a missing pages/review.html and a changed score exited 0 and committed docs/assets/data/review.json with the new score. docs/review.html kept the old route state and the old pass item.
A temp copy with a complete score and no published baseline committed docs/review.html and left docs/assets/data/review.json absent.
F1 fixed: the flag selects the branch at update.sh:172-178. A flagless run with the record stays preview-only, and the F1 case pins it.
F2 and C F8 fixed: update.sh:183-194 compares the consumed score with the published baseline. Both review outputs rebuild and commit exactly when the score differs.
F3 fixed: update.sh:251-265 runs leak-check.ts over the staging candidate folder. The L4 case proves an unrelated staged hit does not refuse.
F4 fixed: update.sh:71 and update.sh:79-82 use MODEL_GUIDE_PRIVATE_DIR with the real default and refuse a missing input by name.
F5 fixed: update.sh:226-271 builds the candidate set, scans it, and copies into docs/ only after the checks pass. A refusal leaves docs/ byte-identical.
C F7 fixed: update.sh:83-86 and update.sh:221-224 refuse a missing or unrendered overview before any write.
C F9 fixed: update.sh:279-288 print one `update: committed <path>` line per committed path and `update: no change` on a no-op.
F6 withdrawn: the plan verify line names each targeted test file. The r6 cases now plant hits in candidate files and use a private folder, so the FR-1 to FR-5 claim holds.
The round 1 nits of Review B F1 and Review C F10 to F14 stay open and harmless. They fail closed and change no public page, so they go to tech debt.

The phase commits keep the role split. The Red commits 8f0ebfd and 1360018 touch test files and the plan only. The Green commit 00d9013 touches update.sh and preview.sh only. The evidence commit a4e85da touches the plan only.
The review found no real-key leak in the range. The private default matches the archived strategy at measure/archive/model_guide/test-strategy.md:1804.
F15 is a defect in the lines the remediation changed. It meets the wrong-result exception because a public page shows a stale result.
